findings.excerpt: ### 13. Protection of action taken in good faith
findings.suggested_review: Potential immunity; preserve remedies for unlawful conduct.

findings.excerpt: No suit, prosecution, or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Chairperson, Member, or any officer acting under the direction of the Commission for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act or any rule made thereunder.
